target.title: fix(slack): suppress room event typing indicators
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #88643.

Slack room events are intentionally resolved as `message_tool_only`, but the Slack dispatch path could still advertise an automatic visible reply by starting typing/status indicators. That made observe-style channel turns look like a reply was coming even though source reply delivery was suppressed unless the model explicitly used the message tool.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix keeps the existing room-event source reply safety policy and aligns Slack lifecycle UI with it: room events now pass `suppressTyping: true` into the channel reply pipeline. Normal Slack channel turns keep the existing typing/status behavior.

This also matches Slack's Assistant API guidance: `assistant.threads.setStatus` auto-opens the thread and Slack documents it should only be called when the app intends to reply in that thread.

## User Impact

Slack channel/group room events no longer show misleading typing/status indicators for turns whose automatic source reply is intentionally tool-only. Explicit message-tool replies remain available, and normal automatic channel replies still get typing/status indicators.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/source-reply-delivery-mode.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/typing-policy.test.ts` on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcg0eddwtw3qx89ycms3dek`: 135 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:changed` on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcg0eddwtw3qx89ycms3dek`: passed.
- `autoreview --mode uncommitted --base origin/main`: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

Live Slack visual proof gap: Slack typing/status visibility is client-side and there is no stable Web API readback for the transient indicator. The patch is pinned at the dispatch boundary with regression tests and current Slack Assistant API documentation.
